name: Oil & Exploration
scope: Upstream oil & gas: exploration and production, oilfield services and equipment, and how global and Indian trends flow through to Indian listed companies.
questions: Global: where are crude and gas prices, demand, supply, inventories and OPEC+ policy, and what do the IEA, EIA, OPEC and major banks forecast for the next 12-24 months?
Global: how much is being invested upstream, where is new supply coming from, and what geopolitical or structural shifts matter for producers and service companies?
India: domestic crude and gas production trend, consumption, import dependence and the import bill.
India: gas pricing (APM formula, new-well premium, HPHT/deepwater ceiling), taxes and levies (windfall tax, cess), and how they change producer realisations.
India: exploration policy (OALP rounds, Oilfields Regulation and Development Amendment Act 2025, PNG Rules, No-Go area release, deepwater mission), targets and discoveries.
India: ONGC, Oil India, Vedanta-Cairn, Reliance KG-D6 production guidance, capex and project pipeline; demand for rigs, vessels and seismic services.
Value chain: producers, oilfield services, equipment and pipes, gas transmission and LNG, refiners - who earns what, and who wins or loses when crude or gas prices move.
Listed companies: for each Indian listed company in the universe, its role, exposure and what the sector trends mean for it, with published sensitivities where available.
Research houses and analysts: what named brokers, rating agencies and boutique firms say about the sector and its stocks.
Risks, catalysts with dates, and the monthly indicators an investor should watch.
